svg.title: dnf copr enable hoffresearch/urna, then dnf install urna
svg.desc: urna, end to end: urna setup on an empty machine (scan, plan, the offline embedder payload, the python env, the doctor checks), then urna tui: open a corpus, ask it, read the cited answer, check the install, quit. Steps: 1 · dnf copr enable: the hoffresearch/urna repository / 2 · dnf install: the rpm of the release binary / 3 · the binary on PATH
